subject: Request: short-term surge cap and blended overage for holiday rollout
messages:
From: Caroline Moss <caroline@brightretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: eng-leads@brightretail.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: Holiday launch — temporary throughput lift and pricing

Hi Logan,

Hope you’re well — we have a confirmed flash sale for Nov 25–28 and need a temporary throughput uplift to avoid throttling. Current forecast shows peak traffic that would exceed our committed throughput by ~1.8x for a 72-hour window.

Can you share:
- A short-term uplift option (1 week max) with a clear weekly fee and a capped overage rate if we exceed the uplift during the window
- Any promotional discount you can offer if we agree to convert the uplift to a 3-month committed add-on after the event
- Turnaround time for paperwork (PO/DocuSign) — procurement needs lead time

We’d like price/examples today if possible. Attaching the launch brief (eng copy sent to eng-leads).

Thanks,
Caroline Moss
Head of Platform, BrightRetail
caroline@brightretail.com

--- Attachment: launch_brief.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Moss <caroline@brightretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: Holiday launch — temporary throughput lift and pricing

Hi Caroline — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the sale. We can support the 72-hour peak with an "ephemeral headroom" package that splits cost into: a fixed weekly uplift fee + a blended overage rate capped for the event. High level:

Option A (Standard uplift) — 7-day window covering Nov 23–29 (covers prep + 72h peak)
- Fixed uplift fee: $9,000 (flat for the 7-day window)
- Blended capped overage: $0.0080 per 1k tokens above uplift cap (capped liability: $18k)

Option B (Promo — convert to commitment)
- Fixed uplift fee: $7,200 (20% promotional discount) if BrightRetail converts to a 3-month reserved add-on within 30 days after the event
- Blended capped overage: $0.0065 per 1k tokens above uplift cap (capped liability: $12k)

We can also waive the one-time uplift setup fee for first-time holiday surges if procurement signs the DocuSign order form within 5 business days. Estimated paperwork turnaround: 48–72 hours after we send the DocuSign link and you return the PO.

I attached a formal quote (surge_pricing_quote_v1.pdf) with a few permutations and the DocuSign placeholder. If you’re comfortable, I can provision the uplift once we have the signed order and a PO number.

Proposed next step: reply with which option you prefer and a PO target number; I’ll copy finance for invoicing.

Logan Wright
Account Executive — Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
--- Attachment: surge_pricing_quote_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>

Requesting approval to:
- Approve the 20% one-time discount on the fixed uplift fee (Option B)
- Cap total overrun liability at $12k for Option B
- Waive the setup fee for this uplift

If you approve, I’ll finalize the DocuSign and confirm start/end dates with Caroline. Also need guidance on whether we should require an initial deposit (we typically do a 25% deposit for ad-hoc surges >$8k).

Thanks — Logan
